verdict.rationale: smolagents supports step-by-step manual execution and memory replay/callbacks (useful for long tool calls spanning days) and agent push_to_hub/from_hub for persisting agent definitions, but there is no evidence of native process-restart durability, checkpointing of in-flight execution state, or integration with durable-execution frameworks (e.g., Temporal, Restate). missing for 10: native crash/restart recovery of in-progress runs, state persistence across deploys, durable-execution engine integrations, evidence of production long-running agent durability testing.
